reviews.title: HP laptop that looks to be a true Mac competitor
reviews.body: I have had the HP Omnibook Ultra 14in laptop for a couple of weeks now and so have formed an opinion - overall it's a solid product with lots to like and few quirks. It's good enough power to use on the go especially with if you are not a fan of always connecting to power outlets like me. Surprising
reviews.excerpt: Surprisingly feels lighter than a MacBook Air, guess due to weight distribution on account of a slightly larger footprint.

reviews.title: HP OmniBook Ultra 14 - Works Great for Me!!!!
reviews.body: I bought this device to replace a Dell laptop that was beginning to have issues with managing Zoom meetings at the same time I had other applications open to support what was happening in the Zoom meeting.  The OmniBook solved that for me and the issues I was having before are not happening anymore.
